concept.hr: Pristupni priključak nosi jedan VLAN, trunk označava okvire i nosi sve
concept.en: An access port carries one VLAN; a trunk tags frames and carries them all

summary.hr: Dva preklopnika i jedan kabel: trunk označava svaki okvir VID-om pa nosi oba VLAN-a, pristupna veza nosi samo svoj VLAN, a drugi tiho odsiječe.
summary.en: Two switches, one cable: a trunk tags every frame with its VID and carries both VLANs; an access link carries its own VLAN and silently cuts off the other.
